verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a broad REST API (plus a Python SDK wrapping it) with "full programmatic control" over agent creation, execution and monitoring. Documented endpoints cover listing and resuming agent runs, retrieving logs and traces, banning checks, reading the organization's integrations, generating setup commands, analyzing sandbox logs, and editing pull-request state. However, nothing states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature. UI-side settings such as agent permissions and behavior show no API equivalent, integrations only appear readable rather than configurable, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of org/agent settings and integration configuration, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create and manage AI agents that can write code, fix bugs, and handle development tasks across your repositories with full programmatic control over their execution and monitoring.
The Codegen SDK is a thin pythonic wrapper around the Codegen API with all the same capabilities for creating and managing AI agents programmatically.
Resumes a paused agent run, allowing it to continue processing.
Update the state of a pull request (open, closed, draft, ready_for_review).
Returns a comprehensive overview of all integrations configured for the organization
